questions.question:
A college has 800 students in four streams. Arts has 25% of the students, Science 35%, Commerce 30% and Law the rest. The percentages of girls in Arts, Science, Commerce and Law are 60%, 40%, 50% and 30% respectively.

How many students are in the Science stream?

A college has 800 students in four streams. Arts has 25% of the students, Science 35%, Commerce 30% and Law the rest. The percentages of girls in Arts, Science, Commerce and Law are 60%, 40%, 50% and 30% respectively.

How many girls are in the Arts stream?
questions.explanation: Arts has 25% of 800 = 200 students, and 60% of 200 = 120. The answer is 120.

questions.question:
A college has 800 students in four streams. Arts has 25% of the students, Science 35%, Commerce 30% and Law the rest. The percentages of girls in Arts, Science, Commerce and Law are 60%, 40%, 50% and 30% respectively.

How many students are in the Law stream?
questions.explanation: Law has 100 − 25 − 35 − 30 = 10% of the students: 10% of 800 = 80. The answer is 80.

questions.question:

What is the ratio of girls in Science to girls in Law?
questions.explanation: Girls in Science = 112 and in Law = 24; 112 : 24 simplifies by 8. The ratio is 14 : 3.

questions.explanation: Total profits are P ₹1,200, Q ₹1,600 and R ₹600, so Q gives the highest profit. Answer: Q.

questions.question:
In a survey of 600 people, 45% travel to work by bus and 25% by metro. The rest either use their own vehicle or walk, in the ratio 3 : 2.

How many people travel by metro?

In a survey of 600 people, 45% travel to work by bus and 25% by metro. The rest either use their own vehicle or walk, in the ratio 3 : 2.

How many people use their own vehicle?
questions.explanation: The rest is 30% of 600 = 180; 3/5 of 180 = 108. The answer is 108.

questions.question:
In a survey of 600 people, 45% travel to work by bus and 25% by metro. The rest either use their own vehicle or walk, in the ratio 3 : 2.

How many people walk to work?
questions.explanation: The rest is 180; 2/5 of 180 = 72. The answer is 72.

What is the ratio of bus users to walkers?
questions.explanation: Bus users = 270 and walkers = 72; the HCF is 18. The ratio is 15 : 4.
